jobs.description:
Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Assembling and welding steel structures such as screws, water treatment installations, and other constructions;
  • Building structures according to assembly plans and guidelines;
  • Using various welding techniques: TIG, MIG, and electrode welding;
  • Checking dimensions, shapes, weld seams, and overall quality;
  • Adjusting parts where necessary in case of deformations or defects;
  • Working with different welding machines and, when required, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience or a diploma as a welder, with knowledge of various welding techniques;
  • You possess all required certificates (mandatory);
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently, are allowed to do so, and take initiative;
  • You have basic knowledge of electrical systems and hydraulics;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

• Our client is a well-established Belgian industrial SME operating in the electrical equipment and energy infrastructure sector, delivering innovative solutions for power distribution and electrical installations.
• Combining the agility of a local entrepreneur-driven organization with an international business exposure, the company serves utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across Belgium and European markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for Medium Voltage and electrical distribution solutions in Belgium and BENELUX.
• Identify new business opportunities and build long-term relationships with key stakeholders including utilities, electrical contractors, engineering firms, panel builders, and industrial customers.
• Promote and develop the portfolio of Medium Voltage equipment and power distribution solutions.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor, supporting customers in product selection, applications, and industry requirements.
• Monitor market developments, industry trends, and competitive activities to identify growth opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Management teams to drive business performance and support future business unit development.

• Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in technical sales, business development, or BU management (P&L management) within the electrical distribution sector.
• Strong knowledge of Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, power distribution equipment, switchgear, MCCBs, RMUs, DSO or related electrical solutions.
• Commercially driven with the ability to build relationships and develop new business opportunities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a professional command of English.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry in Zottegem, is currently looking for a motivated operator to join the packaging department on the permanent night shift.

What will your responsibilities be?
As a packaging operator, you are an essential link in our client’s production process.
Multitasking, precision and working at a fast pace are your strengths.

Your responsibilities:
 
• You will mainly be responsible for packaging the finished products. 
• You will regularly carry out quality checks. 
• You will ensure that packaging materials are supplied to the production line. 
• You will set up your machine and keep it running smoothly. 
• Labelling and logistical tasks will also be part of your responsibilities. 
• Finally, you will ensure a clean and tidy working environment.
The working hours are from Sunday evening until Friday morning on a permanent night shift:
Sunday: 22:00–06:00
Monday: 22:00–06:00
Tuesday: 22:00–06:00
Wednesday: 22:00–06:00
Thursday: 22:00–06:00
 
• You have some previous experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry. 
• You are available to start soon. 
• You speak Dutch and/or English fluently. 
• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job on a permanent night shift. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings prepared by the engineering department;
  • Measuring finished parts and comparing them with the technical drawings;
  • Checking the quality of the manufactured parts;

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You can operate an overhead crane or are willing to learn this internally;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test
• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

jobs.occupation: Credit Risk Analyst - International Banking - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is an international corporate and investment banking institution with a strong presence across EMEA. The Belgian office acts as a strategic regional booking center and works closely with international stakeholders across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

The organization combines a highly professional banking environment with a collaborative and multicultural culture. Decision-making is thoughtful and risk-conscious, with a strong focus on compliance, integrity, teamwork, respect, diversity, equity & inclusion, and long-term client relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze corporate lending and transaction requests from a credit risk perspective.
• Assess financial performance, business models, cash flows, and transaction structures.
• Prepare credit applications and recommendations for local credit committees.
• Monitor portfolio developments and identify emerging credit risks.
• Collaborate closely with Relationship Managers across Europe.
• Work alongside Compliance, Risk Management, Treasury, and Operations teams.
• Ensure transactions comply with internal risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
• Support continuous improvement of credit assessment processes and reporting.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• As from 2 years of experience in Credit Analysis, Corporate Banking, Risk for large companies
• Strong understanding of financial statements, credit risk fundamentals, and financial analysis.
• Ability to assess creditworthiness and formulate balanced risk recommendations.
• Excellent analytical skills and high attention to detail.
• Fluent in English with at least one additional European language.
• Proactive, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.
• Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Diligent, professional, intellectually curious, and commercially aware.

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.

To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

For this fast-growing Belgian company with various subsidiaries in Europe, we are currently looking for an accountant to join an experienced finance department.
 

In this role, you are in charge of a portfolio of projects at various stages of development. You will be responsible for all accounting, tax (in cooperation with an external accounting & tax consultancy) and administrative requirements.
 

The job is based in Olen.
 

 
 

Accountant – The Role:
 

- 
 Review the booking of various invoices (AP/AR/bank statements)
 

- 
 Prepare the month- and year-end closings, as well as the annual accounts
 

- 
 Prepare the monthly VAT return, as well at the corporate tax return
 

- 
 Regular reporting to the company’s Finance Manager
 

 

Accountant – About You:
 

- 
 You have obtained a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
 

- 
 You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar role
 

- 
 You are fluent in Dutch & English

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:
	
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.	
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.	
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.	
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.	
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.	
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!
	
• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.	
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.	
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.	
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.	
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.	
• You have basic PC skills.	
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.	
• You speak good Dutch or English.
